3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I had invited Vina on a yacht trip from Topes out to view the Esqiris gas field.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I was curious how progress on the expansion I'd ordered was coming along. And it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: I hadn't visited since its expansion had been completed. And it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: After several decades of operation, it was to be decommissioned and turned into a marine reserve. I was curious about the project, and it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: The Rizania was anchored a few hundred meters offshore. I stood on the aft deck, awaiting Vina's arrival.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: Claiming she was tired of being hounded by the press, she'd asked to take a dinghy incognito from a nearby port.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: She secured the boat and climbed out to join me on the deck, followed by Manus Sazon.

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "What a pleasant surprise. Vina, why didn't you tell me you'd be bringing company?"

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "You. How dare you even show your face in front of me?"

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Relax, Mr. Sazon. I know coming here wasn't your idea."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Are you two insane? Do you want to add fuel to the rumors?"

25.speaker: Manus Sazon
25.text: "Your daughter is a hard woman to say no to. But you know that more than I do."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Vina breathed a sigh of relief.

27.speaker: Vina Toras
27.text: "I'm sorry, Father. I wasn't sure how you would react."

29.speaker: Vina Toras
29.text: "He didn't want to come today, Father. I convinced him."

30.speaker: Vina Toras
30.text: "That's partly why I asked him to join us, Father."

31.speaker: Vina Toras
31.text: "I wanted a chance for the three of us to speak in private. Out of the way of the press."

35.speaker: Manus Sazon
35.text: "There are certain conversations regarding Rizia's direction that have yet to be followed up on."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "Apologies, Mr. Sazon. This yacht has seen better days."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Aye, she's beginning to show her age, but she's a fine vessel."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "It's about time I had my ship restored."

40.speaker: Manus Sazon
40.text: "It's a sight grander than the schooner my mother and I used to putter around in."

42.speaker: Vina Toras
42.text: "Our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

43.speaker: Manus Sazon
43.text: "Ah, well, if the King sees the utility in maintaining such a craft, I would not dare to oppose him."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "What a piece of junk. I should have it scrapped."

45.speaker: Vina Toras
45.text: "Our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel, anyway. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

46.speaker: Manus Sazon
46.text: "Ah, well, if the King believes such a craft is no longer necessary, I wouldn't dare to disagree with him."

47.speaker: Vina Toras
47.text: "You're too polite. The Rizania hasn't been restored since before Mother died."

48.speaker: Vina Toras
48.text: "But our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

49.speaker: Manus Sazon
49.text: "Ah, well, if the King sees the utility in maintaining such a craft, I would not dare to oppose him."

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: We settled around a table on the upper deck. A server came around with orange juice and light refreshments.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: They looked at each other and laughed.

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: I looked around. We were surrounded by open ocean, with the gas field yet to come into view.

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "What is it? Your king commands you to speak."

61.speaker: Vina Toras
61.text: "I don't think it's a secret that the two of us connected in Sallabes."

65.speaker: Vina Toras
65.text: "After our visit to Sallabes, I made the bold step of asking for Mr. Sazon's postal address."

67.speaker: Vina Toras
67.text: "We've been corresponding since then. And speaking on the phone when we've had time."

68.speaker: Vina Toras
68.text: "Thank you Father. Of course I see it the same way, but it means a lot to hear it from you."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false)

70.speaker: Manus Sazon
70.text: "I confess, I withheld my feelings at first, fearing reprisal from the King. Yet the more we spoke and wrote, the more I realized what a fool I'd be to walk away from such a beautiful, inspiring woman."

72.speaker: Manus Sazon
72.text: "We both know better than to rush into marriage. But it is our hope that you will give your blessing to our relationship."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "I would love nothing more than to grant my full-throated approval to your bond."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "You don't need my blessing. Vina is a grown woman and her romantic life is none of my business."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Because any children this union produces will carry the last name Sazon. The Toras dynasty will be destroyed."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "But if this union produces children, it will destroy the Toras dynasty."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "But I would kindly ask you to consider going to Pales regardless. I'm sure Mr. Sazon will still be here when you return."
83.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Because your boyfriend here is trying to destroy the Rizian monarchy."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "But I do wonder if Mr. Sazon is truly motivated by love, or by his house's anti-monarchist aims."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: As the small craft pulled up alongside my yacht, I realized my daughter wasn't alone.

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: Manus bowed. The two of them regarded me nervously.

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Good idea. We three have a lot to talk about."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "I don't like this. But seeing as Mr. Sazon came all this way, I'll indulge you both."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "I've got time for a short chat. But our main purpose is to have a look at the gas field."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Fine. But be glad I'm not beheading you both for your insolence."
99.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_OverthrowMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true)

101.speaker: Manus Sazon
101.text: "Of course. I won't trouble you for long."

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: The yacht pulled up anchor and we began our journey out to the Esqiris field.

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: As we ascended to the upper deck, I noted the Rizania's shabby state of repairs. The paint was peeling in places, and a few of the fixtures were rusted.

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "Whatever you two have to say, it can wait. Vina, we need to talk about Pales."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: My daughter composed herself. I saw worry in her eyes.

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "They are requesting a diplomatic liaison for our gas deal. I said I knew just the woman for the job."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "I am sending you there to serve as diplomatic liaison for the final stages of our gas agreement."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "In order to maintain peaceful relations with the Grand Duchy, it is vitally important that you travel there to oversee our gas deal."

123.speaker: Vina Toras
123.text: "You wouldn't let me onto your council, but you'd entrust me with important diplomatic duties?"

124.speaker: Vina Toras
124.text: "Are you sure they'd want me, Father? I've never carried out any diplomatic duties before."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "It's mostly a symbolic role. Nothing to it, really."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "You don't have a say in the matter. You're going no matter what."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "The council would have been no fun for you. Pales will be an adventure."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "Diplomatic duties should come secondary. What I *actually* want you to do is keep an eye on Duke Reinhart."

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: Both Vina and Manus gaped at me in surprise.

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Why not? I already know you're good at sneaking around."

137.speaker: Vina Toras
137.text: "Oh. A little like my current role, then."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "If you can serve on the council, you can do this. It's good preparation for being queen."

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: She looked questioningly at Manus. He nodded.

141.speaker: Vina Toras
141.text: "That doesn't change what we were about to ask you."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: Manus leaned forward to interject. Vina shook her head.

146.speaker: Vina Toras
146.text: "I do want to go. But it would be nice if it was my choice."

150.speaker: Vina Toras
150.text: "I have a life in Porte Drazon. I'd rather not leave it behind."

154.speaker: Vina Toras
154.text: "And if I don't want to go?"

158.speaker: Vina Toras
158.text: "Well, if you think I'd be good at it..."

159.speaker: Vina Toras
159.text: "But if you think it would help keep the peace with Pales, I'll do it."

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "Please, Vina. It'll be for a year at the very longest."

164.speaker: Vina Toras
164.text: "But I do understand that royals don't always have that luxury. I will accept the task."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "If you truly don't want to go, I'll send an envoy. But to be perfectly honest, I think you would be better at it."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "It's you or nobody. You're the only person I trust enough for the job."

168.speaker: Vina Toras
168.text: "I don't know about that. But if it means so much to you, I'll do it."

169.speaker: Vina Toras
169.text: "A year is a long time, Father..."

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: She looked questioningly at Manus. He nodded.

171.speaker: Vina Toras
171.text: "There's a reason I don't want to leave Rizia."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "I will respect your decision. I will not force you to go someplace you don't want to be."

179.speaker: Vina Toras
179.text: "I... I have no idea what you mean."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Pales has been linked to the Friendship Day bombing in Zille. I want you to find out more if you can."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "Nothing that dramatic. Just let me know if you see or hear anything suspicious."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "If the deal goes south, we'll need leverage. Try and dig up some dirt on the Duke."

189.speaker: Vina Toras
189.text: "I-- I see. It's a tall order, but I can try."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "No buts. Go for it, you crazy kids."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: She looked at me in confusion.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: She looked at me in confusion.

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Still, I must say I have reservations about your future children carrying the name Sazon."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Do I have to have a reason? When I say no, I mean no."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "What life? I thought you'd appreciate the chance to get away from your old man."

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: She looked at Manus. He reached over and squeezed her hand reassuringly.

214.speaker: Manus Sazon
214.text: "It's a wonderful opportunity, Your Highness. You should take it."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "I would only ask that we refrain from publicizing your relationship until Vina's return."

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: She looked at Manus. He gave her a reassuring glance.

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "I am the King. If I order you to go, you'll go."

220.speaker: Vina Toras
220.text: "Give Manus and myself your official blessing, and I will do as you ask."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: Manus reached over and squeezed Vina's hand.

227.speaker: Narrator
227.text: Manus reached over and squeezed Vina's hand.

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "But Vina, there's something more important I wanted to bring up with you. About Pales."
228.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: She looked at me in confusion.

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: Manus reached over and squeezed Vina's hand.

233.speaker: Manus Sazon
233.text: "It's fine, my love. I am willing to wait however long it takes."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "But in exchange, I want you to agree to go to Pales."
234.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

235.speaker: Narrator
235.text: Manus reached over and squeezed her hand.

236.speaker: Manus Sazon
236.text: "You should go, my love. I'll be here when you get back."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "You have not granted my request to go to Pales. Why should I grant yours?"
237.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false)

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "It'll go more smoothly in Pales if Duke Reinhart thinks you're single."

239.speaker: Narrator
239.text: She looked at me in disgust.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: Manus reached over and squeezed her hand.

242.speaker: Manus Sazon
242.text: "You should go, my love. I'll be here when you get back."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "You wouldn't have to touch him. Just flirt a little."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "You have to admit he's incredibly handsome."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "This is the reality of royal politics. If you can't accept that, maybe you're not cut out to be queen."

248.speaker: Vina Toras
248.text: "I will not tolerate such talk. Manus, let's go."

249.speaker: Narrator
249.text: She glanced unhappily at Manus. He squeezed her hand reassuringly.

250.speaker: Manus Sazon
250.text: "I trust you, my love. And I'm willing to wait for as long as it takes."

252.speaker: Manus Sazon
252.text: "We're in the middle of the ocean, my love."

253.speaker: Manus Sazon
253.text: "And unfortunately, there is some wisdom in your father's words. I am willing to wait for his blessing until your return."

256.speaker: Vina Toras
256.text: "Very well. We'll expect your blessing upon my return from Pales."

260.speaker: Vina Toras
260.text: "Very well. Father, if you give us your blessing, I will do as you ask without question."

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: She glanced unhappily at Manus. He turned towards me.

262.speaker: Manus Sazon
262.text: "Your Majesty, you requested my cooperation in reforming the Rizian government."

266.speaker: Manus Sazon
266.text: "If you give us your approval, all of House Sazon will back whatever plans you have. You shouldn't underestimate their value to the Crown."

267.speaker: Manus Sazon
267.text: "Your Majesty, you have indicated hat you wish to preserve Rizia's current system of government."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: Her voice assumed a patient tone.

270.speaker: Vina Toras
270.text: "*If* there are ever children, their last names can be changed by royal decree. House Toras will remain on the throne."

271.speaker: Manus Sazon
271.text: "My family won't like that, of course. But if I must sacrifice my name to be with your daughter, I will."

273.speaker: Manus Sazon
273.text: "Your Majesty, my feelings for your daughter transcend any political goals."

274.speaker: Manus Sazon
274.text: "If you give us your approval, you will have House Sazon's full cooperation in preserving the current system of government."

275.speaker: Manus Sazon
275.text: "My relatives still hold considerable power and influence in Brenas. You shouldn't underestimate their value to the Crown."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "But you might have to go to Pales."
276.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: Vina and Manus looked at each other excitedly.

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: Her voice assumed a patient tone.

281.speaker: Vina Toras
281.text: "*If* there are ever children, their last names can be changed by royal decree. House Toras will remain on the throne."

282.speaker: Manus Sazon
282.text: "My family won't like that, of course. "But if I must sacrifice my name to be with your daughter, I will."

305.speaker: Vina Toras
305.text: "Very well, Father. We'll expect your approval upon my return."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "Then you have my official permission. Just don't get yourself pregnant before marriage."

309.speaker: Vina Toras
309.text: "Certainly not. There won't be a chance for it in Pales, anyway."

311.speaker: Narrator
311.text: On the horizon, the Esqirus field was beginning to come into view.

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "Your *full* cooperation? Including in the House of Delegates?"

313.speaker: Manus Sazon
313.text: "We will always try to push forward policies that benefit commoners. But do this for us, and the voices of opposition will grow considerably quieter."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Your house should be cooperating with me anyway, Mr. Sazon. Need I remind you that I am the King?"

315.speaker: Manus Sazon
315.text: "I-- well, yes, of course. But with a closer union, we could be even more useful to you than the Azaros."

316.speaker: Player_Romus
316.text: "You'd let go of your claims, titles, and lands just like that?"

318.speaker: Manus Sazon
318.text: "If you give us your approval, you will have House Sazon's full cooperation in that matter."

319.speaker: Manus Sazon
319.text: "My relatives still hold considerable power and influence in Brenas. You shouldn't underestimate their value to the Crown."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "I do not need your house's cooperation. And in fact, you should consider yourselves lucky I haven't thrown you all in prison."

322.speaker: Manus Sazon
322.text: "I assure you we do, Your Majesty."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Very well. Once Vina returns from Pales, we will make your relationship public."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Let's make a deal. If Vina agrees to go to Pales, we can go public with your relationship now."
333.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "But I do wonder if Mr. Sazon is truly motivated by love, or by his house's anti-monarchist aims."

339.speaker: Manus Sazon
339.text: "Your Majesty, my feelings for your daughter transcend any political goals."

340.speaker: Manus Sazon
340.text: "As long as we are allowed to be together, you will have House Sazon's full cooperation in preserving the current system of government."

342.speaker: Manus Sazon
342.text: "My relatives in Brenas do have their doubts about the current Duke of Iza. But they will endeavor to respect his wishes."

345.speaker: Manus Sazon
345.text: "I assure you we do, Your Majesty."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "You'd compromise your own values to be with Vina?"

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "I do not need your house's cooperation. And in fact, you should all consider yourselves lucky to still have your heads."

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: I looked at Vina. A frown had formed on her face.

349.speaker: Vina Toras
349.text: "My love, Father has already told us we don't need his blessing. You don't need to appease him."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I am feeling gracious today. You have my blessing, effective immediately."
350.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "When you truly love someone, not even the King can stand in your way. I know what it's like."
351.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_LovedWife"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_LovedWife"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

364.speaker: Vina Toras
364.text: "You'll wait for me until my return from Pales?"

365.speaker: Manus Sazon
365.text: "For you, Your Highness, I would wait an eternity."

366.speaker: Vina Toras
366.text: "In that case, Father, I will accept the Pales diplomatic position. As long as Mr. Sazon has the patience to wait for me."
366.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

367.speaker: Narrator
367.text: They embraced tightly. A content silence descended.

368.speaker: Vina Toras
368.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

369.speaker: Vina Toras
369.text: "Not that we *needed* your approval. But this makes everything easier."

372.speaker: Vina Toras
372.text: "Very well. Father, if you give us your blessing, I will do as you ask without question."

373.speaker: Narrator
373.text: Manus looked at me, his expression serious.

374.speaker: Manus Sazon
374.text: "You have my infinite gratitude for this, Your Majesty."

377.speaker: Manus Sazon
377.text: "For you, Your Highness, I would wait an eternity."

379.speaker: Vina Toras
379.text: "Very well, Father. I will do as you ask. As long as Mr. Sazon is willing to wait for me."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "A man who can't pass on his name to his heirs is like an amoeba, Mr. Sazon."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "That's very honorable of you. Although I am worried about losing your house's favor."

384.speaker: Vina Toras
384.text: "And a woman, Father? What does that make us?"

385.speaker: Vina Toras
385.text: "I daresay losing favor with House Toras will be worse."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "Manus Toras. It does have a nice ring to it."

387.speaker: Vina Toras
387.text: "We were thinking of hyphenating. But this is all far in the future."

388.speaker: Manus Sazon
388.text: "I don't put much stock in names, Your Majesty. It's my hope that my legacy will live on, even if my name doesn't."

389.speaker: Manus Sazon
389.text: "A closer union between our houses will benefit us both, Your Majesty. Even if my name is not attached to it."

390.speaker: Manus Sazon
390.text: "And of course, it's entirely your decision."

391.speaker: Manus Sazon
391.text: "It can never hurt to have the favor of the King of Rizia, Your Highness."

401.speaker: Vina Toras
401.text: "You'll wait for me until my return from Pales?"

402.speaker: Manus Sazon
402.text: "For you, I would wait an eternity."

403.speaker: Vina Toras
403.text: "In that case, Father... I will accept the Pales diplomatic position. As long as Mr. Sazon has the patience to wait for me."
403.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

404.speaker: Vina Toras
404.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "A man who can't pass on his name to his heirs is like an amoeba, Mr. Sazon."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "That's very honorable of you. Although I am worried about losing your house's favor."

407.speaker: Vina Toras
407.text: "And a woman, Father? What does that make us?"

408.speaker: Vina Toras
408.text: "I daresay losing favor with House Toras will be worse."

409.speaker: Player_Romus
409.text: "Manus Toras. It does have a nice ring to it."

410.speaker: Vina Toras
410.text: "We were thinking of hyphenating. But this is all far in the future."

411.speaker: Manus Sazon
411.text: "I don't put much stock in names, Your Majesty. It's my hope that my legacy will live on, even if my name doesn't."

412.speaker: Manus Sazon
412.text: "A closer union between our houses will benefit us both, Your Majesty. Even if my name is not attached to it."

413.speaker: Manus Sazon
413.text: "And of course, it's entirely your decision."

414.speaker: Vina Toras
414.text: "Come now, Manus. It's unbecoming of you to grovel."

415.speaker: Vina Toras
415.text: "Father, you once told me I could love whomever I wanted. This is my choice."

419.speaker: Vina Toras
419.text: "I know princesses don't always get to choose their partners. But Father, he makes me the happiest I've been since Mother died."

420.speaker: Narrator
420.text: Vina looked directly into my eyes.

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "I cannot approve this union. Vina, you are going to Pales. Mr. Sazon, if I catch you trying to contact her, I will have your head."
421.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true)

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "I am feeling gracious today. You have my blessing, effective immediately."

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "I cannot approve this union. Vina, you are to cut off all contact from this man. Mr. Sazon, if you are ever seen with her in public, I'll have your head."
423.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: "My deepest apologies to you both. But it is politically advantageous for Vina to remain single for the time being."
424.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false)

425.speaker: Narrator
425.text: They looked at each other excitedly.

426.speaker: Vina Toras
426.text: "Thank you, Father. This means the world to us."

427.speaker: Manus Sazon
427.text: "Indeed, Your Majesty. You have my infinite gratitude."

437.speaker: Vina Toras
437.text: "That's what I am to you? A bargaining chip?"

439.speaker: Vina Toras
439.text: "Come on, Manus. We have to get off this ship right this second."

440.speaker: Narrator
440.text: She stood up furiously. Manus grabbed her hand.

441.speaker: Manus Sazon
441.text: "We're too far from shore, Your Highness. We don't have enough fuel to make it back from here."

442.speaker: Manus Sazon
442.text: "And as long as your father is king, we must do as he commands."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "It is not my blessing you should worry about, but God's."

447.speaker: Narrator
447.text: They were silent for a second. Vina spoke up again cautiously.

448.speaker: Vina Toras
448.text: "So... do we have God's blessing, Father?"

449.speaker: Narrator
449.text: She nodded slowly. I saw a dangerous glint in her eye.

450.speaker: Vina Toras
450.text: "Yes. As long as he is king."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Feel free to see each other in secret. But we cannot risk angering Rizia's other houses."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "Your mother and I put aside our true feelings for the good of the country. It's your turn now."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "Please, Vina. If you love your father and this country, you'll understand."

457.speaker: Narrator
457.text: She seemed to think about it for a second.

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "You're not a bargaining chip; you're a supremely intelligent young woman. Which is why you'll realize that making this relationship public right now will jeopardize my reign in the present and yours in the future."

463.speaker: Vina Toras
463.text: "No. It's all bullshit! You don't care about me, I'm just another one of your subjects..."

465.speaker: Narrator
465.text: Her shoulders slumped. Manus made an attempt to appear cheerful.

466.speaker: Manus Sazon
466.text: "Our time will come, my love. If not now, then someday."

467.speaker: Narrator
467.text: Nobody spoke for a while. Eventually, the sound of faint industrial noises could be heard. We were nearing the Esqiris field.

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "This does not mean I approve of your relationship, though."

473.speaker: Player_Romus
473.text: "And you know what? I'll graciously allow you to begin dating in public. Effective immediately."

479.speaker: Player_Romus
479.text: "It's not your choice, Vina. You will go to Pales. And if I find out that Mr. Sazon has been trying to contact you, I'll have his head."

480.speaker: Player_Romus
480.text: "I wish I could approve. But it is politically advantageous for Vina to remain single at this point in time."

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "There will be no discussion. You're going to Pales, and you will break off contact with Mr. Sazon."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "It's a deal. Accept this position, and you two can consider yourselves blessed."

486.speaker: Vina Toras
486.text: "You could have opposed our relationship, and you didn't. So I'll do as you ask."

487.speaker: Vina Toras
487.text: "Assuming Mr. Sazon is willing to wait for me, of course."

488.speaker: Manus Sazon
488.text: "For you, Your Highness, I would wait an eternity."

489.speaker: Player_Romus
489.text: "I'm sorry, both of you. But I can't give you my blessing to be together. It's too risky politically."

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "I do not want my grandchildren carrying the Sazon name."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "This man's house is brimming with anti-monarchists. I want him as far from the throne as possible."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "Perhaps He will approve if you agree to go to Pales."
504.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false)

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "You do. But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "It is God's will that you go to Pales."
509.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_TalkToAboutPalesTrip"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_VinaManus_PalesTalk"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false)

516.speaker: Player_Romus
516.text: "I hope one day that I can find a love as pure as yours."
516.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_LovedWife"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

520.speaker: Vina Toras
520.text: "But I thought -- well. I'm sure it'll happen, Father."

524.speaker: Player_Romus
524.text: "He has ordained that the Toras family will hold the throne for centuries to come. If you bear children with the Sazon name, it will ruin his plans."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "It depends. Have you been fornicating out of wedlock?"

528.speaker: Manus Sazon
528.text: "Never, Your Majesty. I would not defile the honor of the Princess of Rizia."

529.speaker: Vina Toras
529.text: "I can't believe either of you. If a woman's honor is tied to her maidenhead, I lost mine long ago while horseback riding."

533.speaker: Vina Toras
533.text: "You're asking a lot of me. But I can try."

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: "If you swear to abide by His laws and keep Him dear in your hearts... then yes, you do."

548.speaker: Vina Toras
548.text: "In the meantime, I regretfully turn down the Pales diplomatic position."

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "And why is that? Maybe some time abroad will help you get a fresh perspective."

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "No, you already agreed to it. You're going."

559.speaker: Narrator
559.text: She looked at Manus. He didn't say anything.

560.speaker: Vina Toras
560.text: "No. I'm doing enough for you already, Father. You'll just have to find someone else."

562.speaker: Manus Sazon
562.text: "Your father is right, Your Highness. Please don't reject this valuable opportunity on my account."

564.speaker: Vina Toras
564.text: "Fine. I will go. But I hope you're not expecting me to work miracles over there."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "Come. Let all three of us behold the majestic gas extraction capabilities of the Kingdom of Rizia."

567.speaker: Player_Romus
567.text: "I'm going to the bow to have a closer look. You may join if you wish."

571.speaker: Narrator
571.text: Manus and Vina nodded to each other, then got up from their seats and walked with me to the ship's bow.

575.speaker: Narrator
575.text: They exchanged uneasy looks, then rose and walked to join me at the ship's bow.

582.speaker: Narrator
582.text: The expanded gas field was a sight to behold. A veritable city of metal drilling rigs rose out of the sea in front of us, connected by a labyrinth of platforms, cables and pipelines.

583.speaker: Narrator
583.text: Even in its partially completed state, the expanded gas field was a sight to behold. Yellow-vested construction workers swarmed over a towering set of metal drilling rigs, connected by a labyrinth of platforms, cables and pipelines.

584.speaker: Narrator
584.text: The decommissioning of the gas field was still underway. Yellow-vested construction workers swarmed over the metal drilling rigs, uncoupling cables and dismantling pipelines.

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "See, Vina? This is why it's so important that the Pales deal goes smoothly. We can no longer rely on domestic gas production."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Good thing we've got lots of energy reserves to fall back on."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "See, Vina? This is why you should've agreed to help with the Pales deal. We can no longer rely on domestic gas production."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "Well, Lord knows how we're going to meet all our energy needs now."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "We've got to win that arbitration case now."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "We're really going to need the Aureus field now."

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "Good riddance. The ocean will flourish without it."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "Make sure to mention this when you're in Pales, Vina. We have our own gas. We're not desperate for the Grand Duke's."

608.speaker: Player_Romus
608.text: "This is why I'm not forcing you to go to Pales, Vina. We've got plenty of our own gas to fall back on."

612.speaker: Player_Romus
612.text: "Hey Vina, remember when you were six and only wanted to eat cabbage for a week? When this baby's up and running, we'll have even more gas than that!"

624.speaker: Player_Romus
624.text: "Hey Vina, remember when you were six and only wanted to eat cabbage for a week? Now that this baby's up and running, we'll have even more gas than that!"

625.speaker: Player_Romus
625.text: "This investment had better be worth it."

626.speaker: Player_Romus
626.text: "There's something strangely beautiful about it, isn't there?"

631.speaker: Narrator
631.text: Vina didn't respond. She stared out at the sea in stony silence.
631.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Project"] == true) == false)

635.speaker: Vina Toras
635.text: "So I see. I hope the destruction of marine habitats is worth it."

636.speaker: Vina Toras
636.text: "Worth the destruction of marine habitats? I hope so too."

640.speaker: Narrator
640.text: Manus grinned and squeezed her shoulder.

646.speaker: Vina Toras
646.text: "Mmm. I don't find anything beautiful about the destruction of marine habitats."

650.speaker: Manus Sazon
650.text: "You'd rather we go back to coal and oil? This is the cleanest, safest energy source out there."

654.speaker: Manus Sazon
654.text: "Except for my province's hydroelectric dam, of course. You have our thanks for that, Your Majesty."

655.speaker: Player_Romus
655.text: "Actually, so-called 'clean' hydroelectric plants still have a deleterious effect on river systems."

656.speaker: Player_Romus
656.text: "Greater energy independence is a win for all of us, Mr. Sazon."

661.speaker: Player_Romus
661.text: "I am glad your house appreciates my generosity."

663.speaker: Manus Sazon
663.text: "Yes, both my house and the RPP are happy to see Rizia making progress on that front."

664.speaker: Manus Sazon
664.text: "Oh. Well, I still consider it progress."

670.speaker: Manus Sazon
670.text: "It may not be perfect, but it's progress."

671.speaker: Manus Sazon
671.text: "We do. And your eye towards progress."

672.speaker: Narrator
672.text: Manus laughed in spite of himself.

673.speaker: Manus Sazon
673.text: "A dad joke. Now that's something I never heard growing up."

690.speaker: Vina Toras
690.text: "Yes, I know. I won't let you down."

691.speaker: Vina Toras
691.text: "Maybe it's time we finally got away from natural gas as an energy source."

698.speaker: Manus Sazon
698.text: "There's still the Zpana hydroelectric dam. Which my family thanks you for, Your Majesty."

699.speaker: Narrator
699.text: Vina shot him a look of betrayal.

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "Greater energy independence is a win for all of us, Mr. Sazon."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "See, Vina? Someone on this boat knows how to be grateful."

706.speaker: Player_Romus
706.text: "We'll get some energy from that plant. I wish it was more."

707.speaker: Vina Toras
707.text: "Agreed. We really ought to find a way to power ourselves without relying on dirty gas."

709.speaker: Manus Sazon
709.text: "Just don't let yourself get distracted by Duke Dashing."

710.speaker: Player_Romus
710.text: "Truth be told, Duke Reinhart is much less handsome in person."

712.speaker: Player_Romus
712.text: "My daughter's not one to swoon over a handsome face."

713.speaker: Player_Romus
713.text: "You dare accuse my daughter of being unfaithful?"

714.speaker: Vina Toras
714.text: "He and his entire family are parasites. There's nothing less attractive than that."

718.speaker: Vina Toras
718.text: "He seems arrogant, not my type at all."

720.speaker: Manus Sazon
720.text: "I still consider it progress, Your Majesty."

721.speaker: Manus Sazon
721.text: "Sorry, Your Highness, but His Majesty and I still have a working relationship to maintain."

722.speaker: Manus Sazon
722.text: "Yes, both my house and the RPP are happy to see Rizia making progress on that front."

723.speaker: Narrator
723.text: Manus chuckled politely. Vina rolled her eyes.

734.speaker: Manus Sazon
734.text: "No, you prefer your men bookish and sweaty."

736.speaker: Manus Sazon
736.text: "Come now. Who *isn't* a parasite in your book?"

737.speaker: Manus Sazon
737.text: "Now, Vina. Natural gas is the cleanest, safest type of energy there is."

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "Careful, Mr. Sazon. We haven't been using it long enough to know its long-term effects."

739.speaker: Player_Romus
739.text: "But it's non-renewable. We use up this field, and it's gone forever."

740.speaker: Player_Romus
740.text: "You're absolutely right. Coal and oil are the past. Natural gas is the future."

742.speaker: Manus Sazon
742.text: "Compared to coal and oil, I would call it progress."

743.speaker: Narrator
743.text: Manus turned towards me, a strained smile on his face.

745.speaker: Manus Sazon
745.text: "While it's just the three of us, may I take the opportunity to follow up on our conversation about reforming the country?"

750.speaker: Vina Toras
750.text: "So was I, after that talk we had in Monqiz."

751.speaker: Player_Romus
751.text: "Do you actually love my daughter, Mr. Sazon? Or is this a political move?"

752.speaker: Manus Sazon
752.text: "Vina is everything to me. I'm just pointing out the benefits a closer union between our houses might bring."

753.speaker: Vina Toras
753.text: "Whatever your feelings about myself and Mr. Sazon as a couple, I believe all three of us want the same thing in the end."

754.speaker: Player_Romus
754.text: "We all want a Rizia ruled by the citizenry, not the nobility."

755.speaker: Player_Romus
755.text: "Indeed. For the royal family to shed our legislative responsibilities while keeping our wealth and status."

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "'Do we really want the same thing? What about the dream of revolution you shared with Chancellor Hegel, Comrade Vina?"

757.speaker: Narrator
757.text: The Rizania completed a slow circle around the gas field and began heading back towards the Topes harbor.
757.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_WorkWithRPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_WorkWithRPP"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] > 0)  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_WorkWithRPP"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] > 0)) == false)

758.speaker: Manus Sazon
758.text: "I'll head out on the dinghy before we reach port. Wouldn't want anyone getting the wrong idea."
758.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] >= 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] >= 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false)

762.speaker: Manus Sazon
762.text: "Our first outing as a couple. I hope we're ready for it."
762.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] >= 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] >= 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false)

763.speaker: Player_Romus
763.text: "Make the most of it, kids. Won't be long before Vina ships off to Pales."

767.speaker: Player_Romus
767.text: "This is what you wanted. Prepare for Voice of Rizia to tear you to shreds."

768.speaker: Player_Romus
768.text: "The gossip columnists answer to the Crown, but they can still be vicious."

769.speaker: Player_Romus
769.text: "Of course everyone will accept you. You're young, beautiful and heterosexual."

773.speaker: Player_Romus
773.text: "That I'm collaborating with the opposition? Heaven forbid."

774.speaker: Player_Romus
774.text: "Don't worry. It won't be long before you can step off the yacht arm in arm with Vina."

778.speaker: Player_Romus
778.text: "That I'm allowing the son of my kidnapper to court my daughter? Yes, genius, that would paint me in a weak light."

779.speaker: Player_Romus
779.text: "That the King of Rizia is engaged in a torrid affair with a man half his age? No, that'd be dreadful."

783.speaker: Player_Romus
783.text: "All I want is to neutralize potential revolutionary elements by giving them a greater say in the lawmaking process."

785.speaker: Narrator
785.text: They looked at each other. Vina gave a small nod.

786.speaker: Manus Sazon
786.text: "Precisely, Your Majesty. And in doing so, we can finally empower the citizens of this kingdom."

787.speaker: Narrator
787.text: A look of horror spread across my daughter's face. Manus took a step backwards.

788.speaker: Vina Toras
788.text: "I-- I was going to tell you. It's not what you think."

789.speaker: Player_Romus
789.text: "What I think is that you humiliated me and undermined your government."

790.speaker: Player_Romus
790.text: "Relax. I'm not angry. Just disappointed that you didn't confide in me."

791.speaker: Player_Romus
791.text: "I had no idea that your hobby interest in communism had gone this far."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "Mr. Sazon, did you know your sweetheart here is a Malenyevist?"

793.speaker: Manus Sazon
793.text: "She did bring up her readings with me, Your Majesty. We thought it safest that you didn't know."

795.speaker: Vina Toras
795.text: "I'm sorry, Father. I thought it was safer that you didn't know."

796.speaker: Vina Toras
796.text: "I know, Father. I truly am sorry."

797.speaker: Vina Toras
797.text: "For what it's worth... I didn't tell the Chancellor I wanted revolution. I asked him if he thought a country like Rizia could adopt Valgslandian Socialist principles without one."

798.speaker: Player_Romus
798.text: "Of course we can. In case you haven't noticed, I've been working day and night to better the situation of commoners."

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "Don't be daft. The aristocracy is blocking our way to true progress, and it is highly unlikely they'll gently step aside."

802.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
802.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Good"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Great"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Good"] == true) == false

803.speaker: Player_Romus
803.text: "I think I know what his answer was."

805.speaker: Player_Romus
805.text: "Of course we can. In fact, tackling the plight of commoners is at the top of my agenda."
805.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Good"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Great"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Good"] == true) == false

806.speaker: Vina Toras
806.text: "He wrote that you can't heal an infected tooth without tearing out its root."

807.speaker: Vina Toras
807.text: "That's what he said. In so many words."

808.speaker: Vina Toras
808.text: "But see, Father, true socialism is implemented from the bottom up. Not the top down."

809.speaker: Manus Sazon
809.text: "I convinced Her Highness that she should talk to you rather than continue her correspondence."

811.speaker: Manus Sazon
811.text: "We've had our disagreements about what that means. In the end, Her Highness made a compelling argument for removing the Rizian aristocracy's political power."

815.speaker: Manus Sazon
815.text: "We both believe that this can be accomplished without fundamentally disrupting Rizia's societal structure."

816.speaker: Vina Toras
816.text: "In turn, Manus convinced me that such a transition can occur gradually, without the need for societal upheaval."

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon. A good match for my headstrong daughter."

821.speaker: Vina Toras
821.text: "Yes. The royal family and the noble houses should guide Rizians through the transition, not abandon them to it."

822.speaker: Player_Romus
822.text: "So you'd ask the aristocracy to just politely step aside? It'll never happen."

823.speaker: Player_Romus
823.text: "I thought for a second you two were going to start advocating for a revolution."

824.speaker: Player_Romus
824.text: "You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon. A good match for my headstrong daughter."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "You're right. I should have stopped media censorship in Rizia as soon as I took the throne."

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "I keep journalists under control for my family's sake. Do you know what lies they'd spread about my daughter if they were let off their leash?"

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "Can't I keep just a little censorship? A king is entitled to keep certain aspects of his private life private, after all."

831.speaker: Manus Sazon
831.text: "That will undermine the cause, Your Majesty. Rizians need an information source they can trust."

832.speaker: Vina Toras
832.text: "I appreciate that you kept me out of the papers during my childhood, Father. But I'm not a little girl anymore."

833.speaker: Manus Sazon
833.text: "It has been too long since the Rizian people had an information source they could trust."

837.speaker: Player_Romus
837.text: "I disagree. Any change has got to be radical, or it's not going to stick."

838.speaker: Vina Toras
838.text: "Look at what's going on around us, Father. Rizia needs change, but we also need stability."

839.speaker: Manus Sazon
839.text: "Go too radical too fast, and you won't live long enough to see it through."

842.speaker: Narrator
842.text: We had reached the far edge of the gas field. The yacht creaked a little as it began to turn around.

843.speaker: Player_Romus
843.text: "What is there to say? It seems like your mind has been made up."

845.speaker: Narrator
845.text: He rested his elbows on the ship's railing.

846.speaker: Manus Sazon
846.text: "On the other hand, if the Rizian People's Party were in power, you would have a much easier time of it."

847.speaker: Player_Romus
847.text: "First you want my daughter, then you want a parliament majority. Why don't I hand you my crown while I'm at it?"

848.speaker: Player_Romus
848.text: "I can't help you with that, Mr. Sazon. If the people want you to win, you'll win."

849.speaker: Vina Toras
849.text: "You know that's not how it works. The system is rigged against the opposition."

850.speaker: Player_Romus
850.text: "If you win, you'll be the head puppets in our puppet parliament. How will that change anything?"

851.speaker: Vina Toras
851.text: "May I just remind you that I'm not yours to 'give'?"

852.speaker: Player_Romus
852.text: "You want me to rig the election? That doesn't sound like you."

853.speaker: Vina Toras
853.text: "The system is already rigged. We're asking you to un-rig it."

854.speaker: Manus Sazon
854.text: "Listen. The makeup of the House of Delegates is determined by the outcome of the provincial council elections, right?"

855.speaker: Manus Sazon
855.text: "You were the one who wanted change, Your Majesty. It'll never happen with de Rava and the RNC in charge."

856.speaker: Vina Toras
856.text: "For the sake of a free press, I'm willing to give up some of my privacy. I just won't read what they print about me."

857.speaker: Vina Toras
857.text: "Besides, Father, what do you even have to hide?"

859.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
859.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true

860.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
860.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false

861.speaker: Player_Romus
861.text: "Uh, nothing. Definitely no secret affairs or anything of that nature."
861.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true

864.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
864.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_Scapegoats"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_Iza_SendBrenasPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true) == false

865.speaker: Player_Romus
865.text: "I most certainly didn't pervert the justice system to serve my own ends."

867.speaker: Player_Romus
867.text: "Absolutely nothing. But that's not the point."

868.speaker: Vina Toras
868.text: "I do realize that opens us up to more public scrutiny. But I'm not a little girl anymore."

869.speaker: Manus Sazon
869.text: "I have one other idea. My party has millions of sympathizers in Rizia who cannot vote for us because they are not citizens."

870.speaker: Narrator
870.text: Manus and Vina politely pretended not to hear me.

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "Now you're *really* trying to get me overthrown."

872.speaker: Vina Toras
872.text: "Giving up some of our privacy now will be worth it in the long run. I bet the papers won't even care about us royals once we're merely symbols."

875.speaker: Manus Sazon
875.text: "And as you know, there's an election coming up."

876.speaker: Manus Sazon
876.text: "The vast majority of the RPP is in favor of reform. The more power we hold -- even if it's only symbolic power -- the stronger the movement becomes."

877.speaker: Player_Romus
877.text: "A sound strategy. The RPP would be able to increase its voter base overnight."

878.speaker: Player_Romus
878.text: "That's a rubbish tactic. The backlash from real Rizians would cancel out any benefit you got from the foreign vote."

879.speaker: Manus Sazon
879.text: "The high-ranking members of your house won't like it. But the rest of Rizia will."

880.speaker: Manus Sazon
880.text: "Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs would lean monarchist. But if we mobilize the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should gain enough votes to come out on top."

881.speaker: Vina Toras
881.text: "'Real' Rizians, Father? What do you call the children of Wehzek civil war refugees who have never known any other home?'"

882.speaker: Manus Sazon
882.text: "It is a risk, Vina. Especially with Su Omina on the rise."

889.speaker: Manus Sazon
889.text: "I know it's a risk. Especially with Su Omina on the rise."

890.speaker: Manus Sazon
890.text: "Such an act wouldn't only benefit my party, you know. Quite a few Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs will opt for the Rizian National Coalition."

891.speaker: Manus Sazon
891.text: "But if we start moblizing the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should gain enough votes to come out on top."

892.speaker: Manus Sazon
892.text: "Rizia is a multicultural country, Your Majesty. It's time for our government to reflect that."

893.speaker: Player_Romus
893.text: "Vina, what do you think of this idea?"

895.speaker: Player_Romus
895.text: "I'm uneasy about this. I fear Rizian national identity will become diluted if just anyone can become a citizen."

896.speaker: Player_Romus
896.text: "Having the interests of the working class represented in government is more important to me."

898.speaker: Vina Toras
898.text: "I think it's long overdue. And it's the fastest way to get Mr. Sazon's party into power. But at the same time..."

899.speaker: Manus Sazon
899.text: "Rizia's foreigners mostly belong to the working class, Your Majesty. So this will accomplish both."

900.speaker: Manus Sazon
900.text: "Perhaps the acceptance of different opinions and cultures should be part of our national identity, Your Majesty."

901.speaker: Vina Toras
901.text: "I confess I'm worried about increasing numbers of Golcondists and Dastnurists participating in elections. What if it sets back the progress we've made on women's rights?"

902.speaker: Player_Romus
902.text: "Don't worry. I am still the king, and I make the rules in the end."

903.speaker: Player_Romus
903.text: "We shouldn't assume all Derdians and Wehzeks hold those beliefs. Many moved here to get away from them."

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "Relax, Vina. The foreign vote will boost the RPP, but they're still far from the majority in this country."

905.speaker: Vina Toras
905.text: "For now. But if we succeed in transferring power to the Delegates..."

906.speaker: Vina Toras
906.text: "Well. We'll just have to see what happens."

909.speaker: Manus Sazon
909.text: "Vina, as long as I'm still speaker of the RPP, I will preserve the gender equality laws your great-grandmother made."

913.speaker: Manus Sazon
913.text: "And those passed by your father, of course."

914.speaker: Narrator
914.text: Manus gave her a confident smile.

919.speaker: Player_Romus
919.text: "I still don't want you dating my daughter, though."

920.speaker: Player_Romus
920.text: "You'd better not let me down. The stakes are too high for all of us."

923.speaker: Narrator
923.text: Vina glowered at me. Manus nodded his assent.

926.speaker: Manus Sazon
926.text: "I am sorry if I misunderstood your intentions, Your Majesty."

927.speaker: Narrator
927.text: I turned my gaze forward. The coast of Topes was starting to come into view.

931.speaker: Manus Sazon
931.text: "And by that time, I might just be House Speaker."

935.speaker: Manus Sazon
935.text: "The price of living in a free country."

936.speaker: Narrator
936.text: Vina gave me a questioning look, but said nothing.

937.speaker: Vina Toras
937.text: "Let them chatter. I'm used to it by now."

941.speaker: Vina Toras
941.text: "It's not fair. We can finally be together, and now I've got to lose you?"

943.speaker: Manus Sazon
943.text: "He's right, love. We're both too pretty for Rizia to resist."

944.speaker: Manus Sazon
944.text: "If they want gossip, we'll give them gossip."

945.speaker: Narrator
945.text: He slipped his arm around Vina's waist. Together, they looked out at the approaching horizon.

946.speaker: Narrator
946.text: I allowed them a moment of privacy and retreated to the cabin to prepare for our arrival.

947.speaker: Manus Sazon
947.text: "The time will pass quickly, love. And with luck, you'll return to a newly elected House Speaker."

951.speaker: Manus Sazon
951.text: "The time will pass quickly, love. And I'll be right here when you return."

952.speaker: Player_Romus
952.text: "Of course everyone will accept you. You're young, beautiful nobles."

953.speaker: Vina Toras
953.text: "Not that the 'noble' part should mean anything."

955.speaker: Narrator
955.text: He turned to look into Vina's eyes.

956.speaker: Manus Sazon
956.text: "The time will pass in an instant, love."

957.speaker: Manus Sazon
957.text: "With luck, Your Majesty, I won't be the opposition for long."

958.speaker: Manus Sazon
958.text: "The next House of Delegates elections are approaching, Your Majesty. I may not be the opposition for long."

965.speaker: Narrator
965.text: He turned to look into Vina's eyes.

966.speaker: Manus Sazon
966.text: "I hope you're ready to come home to a House Speaker, Your Highness."

970.speaker: Manus Sazon
970.text: "The time will pass in an instant, love."

971.speaker: Narrator
971.text: He turned to look into Vina's eyes.

972.speaker: Manus Sazon
972.text: "This is not the end, Your Highness."

973.speaker: Manus Sazon
973.text: "I did not mean to offend you in any way, Your Majesty."

974.speaker: Vina Toras
974.text: "I'll make sure of it. The deal will go off without a hitch."

975.speaker: Vina Toras
975.text: "A House Speaker and an accomplished diplomat. Quite the power couple."

976.speaker: Narrator
976.text: Before Vina or I could respond, he swiftly made his exit down the stairs.

977.speaker: Narrator
977.text: Manus kissed her passionately, then swiftly made his exit down the stairs.

979.speaker: Vina Toras
979.text: "Nobody was in danger of thinking that, Father."

984.speaker: Narrator
984.text: She turned to look into Manus' eyes.

987.speaker: Vina Toras
987.text: "We'll be together soon. I know it."

988.speaker: Narrator
988.text: A few moments later, I heard the thrum of the dinghy's engine, then a metallic clunk as it detached from the yacht's docking platform.

989.speaker: Narrator
989.text: Vina slumped against the bow's railing. I'd rarely seen her this forlorn.

990.speaker: Player_Romus
990.text: "Cheer up. It's not like anyone died."

993.speaker: Vina Toras
993.text: "Manus and I discussed this. I convinced him that his plan for a constitutional monarchy must involve taking power away from the Rizian aristocracy."

994.speaker: Manus Sazon
994.text: "And I convinced Her Highness that some amount of symbolic power is necessary to prevent total societal upheaval."

995.speaker: Narrator
995.text: After a while, faint industrial noises began puncturing the quiet. We were nearing the Esqiris field.

997.speaker: Player_Romus
997.text: "A few months in Pales will take your mind right off him."

998.speaker: Player_Romus
998.text: "Pining over a man? That's not the Vina I know."

1007.speaker: Vina Toras
1007.text: "I'll be in the cabin. Fetch me when we reach Topes."

1008.speaker: Vina Toras
1008.text: "But I don't want to take my mind off him."

1012.speaker: Vina Toras
1012.text: "Then I suppose you don't know me, do you?"

1013.speaker: Vina Toras
1013.text: "Nor the Vina I know. But what can I do?"

1020.speaker: Narrator
1020.text: After a while, she turned away. She seemed as if she could barely stand to look at me.

1021.speaker: Narrator
1021.text: The two of us stood there in silence, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

1023.speaker: Narrator
1023.text: I stayed where I was, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

1024.speaker: Narrator
1024.text: We stood there for a while, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

1040.speaker: Player_Romus
1040.text: "Sorry, but you don't get to choose that either. You're going to Pales."

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "You've both gone mad. Changing the election process would represent a massive break with tradition."

1052.speaker: Player_Romus
1052.text: "And what if it backfires? What if the Rizian National Coalition is what the people really want?"

1053.speaker: Manus Sazon
1053.text: "There's only one way to find out."

1054.speaker: Player_Romus
1054.text: "If I do that, members of all three noble houses might lose their council positions. Including House Sazon, by the way."

1055.speaker: Manus Sazon
1055.text: "What tradition, Your Majesty? The House of Delegates is younger than I am."

1056.speaker: Manus Sazon
1056.text: "Your Majesty, the wider the disconnect between nobles like yourself and the actual citizenry of this country, the greater the potential for actual chaos."

1057.speaker: Manus Sazon
1057.text: "I know. But if the electorate doesn't want them there, they don't deserve to be there."

1061.speaker: Vina Toras
1061.text: "I told you this was a pipe dream, Manus. Father's afraid of finding out what everyone really thinks of us royals."

1062.speaker: Vina Toras
1062.text: "Just imagine, Father. Haven't you always wanted to know what everyone really thinks of us?"

1063.speaker: Manus Sazon
1063.text: "But as long as the provinces' ruling nobles appoint half of the councilors themselves -- overriding the people's wishes -- the monarchists in the RNC will always have an unfair advantage."

1065.speaker: Vina Toras
1065.text: "Take away that power, and the House of Delegates will truly be a parliament of the people. All you have to do is expand the election process to apply to all provincial council appointees."

1066.speaker: Player_Romus
1066.text: "Say what you will about the nobles, but they've provided our kingdom with stability and continuity. If just anyone can become a councilor, chaos will reign."

1067.speaker: Player_Romus
1067.text: "Aren't we better off not knowing? We should rule according to what we believe is just and fair, not bow to the tyranny of the majority."

1068.speaker: Player_Romus
1068.text: "I'm not afraid. I already know that our populace loves us."

1069.speaker: Player_Romus
1069.text: "I already know that our populace loves us."

1070.speaker: Player_Romus
1070.text: "You're wrong. I have long believed that the king should be on the same level with his subjects, not stand head and shoulders above them."

1071.speaker: Player_Romus
1071.text: "Of course. I have long believed that the king should be on the same level with his subjects, not stand head and shoulders above them."

1075.speaker: Player_Romus
1075.text: "There is only one judgement I am worried about. That of God."

1076.speaker: Manus Sazon
1076.text: "Then you'll have nothing to worry about."

1077.speaker: Manus Sazon
1077.text: "Exactly. Only when the Rizian royalty becomes part of ordinary society can we bring everyone together."

1078.speaker: Manus Sazon
1078.text: "I have faith that the majority of Rizians want justice as well."

1079.speaker: Manus Sazon
1079.text: "But would God not want you to serve according to the needs of your subjects?"

1080.speaker: Manus Sazon
1080.text: "I understand that it will not be easy to pass a decree of this magnitude. If we want it done before the elections, we may need help."

1082.speaker: Manus Sazon
1082.text: "Change will find its way to us. Whether we are the ones behind it or not."

1087.speaker: Manus Sazon
1087.text: "You've allowed the Voice of Rizia to resume publication. That alone will sway many people to our side."

1088.speaker: Manus Sazon
1088.text: "We all know that the Royal Herald is extremely biased in favor of the RNC. Allowing the publication of independent newspapers would definitely help sway the electorate."

1095.speaker: Manus Sazon
1095.text: "And several million Rizians of foreign origin have now become naturalized citizens."

1096.speaker: Manus Sazon
1096.text: "You've already passed one decree that will help us greatly. Thanks to you, millions of foreign-born Rizians have become naturalized citizens."

1097.speaker: Manus Sazon
1097.text: "You have the power to allow them to be naturalized as Rizians."

1098.speaker: Manus Sazon
1098.text: "Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs will lean monarchist. But if we mobilize the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should have a significant edge compared to the last elections."

1102.speaker: Player_Romus
1102.text: "I think those measures are a drop in the bucket compared to the election reform you mentioned. Once we get off this boat, I'm passing a decree democratizing the Rizian election process." [-6 Authority]

1104.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
