1105.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1105.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false

1106.speaker: Player_Romus
1106.text: "I think you two have given me a lot to consider."

1107.speaker: Player_Romus
1107.text: "You've convinced me. I will allow both free press and the naturalization of foreigners at once." [-7 Authority, -1 Budget]
1107.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0

1113.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1113.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 4  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false

1114.speaker: Player_Romus
1114.text: "It is high time Rizia had a free press. That's as far as I'll go for now." [-3 Authority]

1115.speaker: Player_Romus
1115.text: "I like the naturalization idea. Let's give the polls some fresh blood." [-4 Authority, -1 Budget]

1124.speaker: Player_Romus
1124.text: "I think the RPP's chances are already pretty good."

1127.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1127.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == true) == false

1128.speaker: Player_Romus
1128.text: "I think that I cannot help you. If you want to win this election, you'll have to do it on your own."
1128.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == true) == false

1133.speaker: Narrator
1133.text: Manus made an effort to smile.

1135.speaker: Narrator
1135.text: Manus practically jumped up and down with excitement.

1138.speaker: Vina Toras
1138.text: "Come on, Manus. You don't need to apologize for anything."

1139.speaker: Narrator
1139.text: My daughter gave him a sympathetic look.

1156.speaker: Player_Romus
1156.text: "The three of us? Have you been discussing this with Vina?"

1157.speaker: Player_Romus
1157.text: "Yes, I was wondering when we'd get to that."

1161.speaker: Narrator
1161.text: Vina put her hands on her hips.

1162.speaker: Vina Toras
1162.text: "I brought it up with him, thank you. I mentioned our conversation in Monqiz, and he told me you'd discussed the same thing in Sallabes."

1163.speaker: Manus Sazon
1163.text: "The topic has come up once or twice."

1164.speaker: Player_Romus
1164.text: "Talk all you want. But I'm still not convinced reforms are the right way to go."

1165.speaker: Vina Toras
1165.text: "I wish you'd brought this up with me earlier, Father."

1169.speaker: Vina Toras
1169.text: "So was I. I'm surprised you never brought this up with me, Father."

1173.speaker: Vina Toras
1173.text: "That's not what you said to me in Monqiz, Father."

1174.speaker: Vina Toras
1174.text: "I shared your reservations, Father. But Manus and I have talked it over."

1178.speaker: Player_Romus
1178.text: "I'm surprised you still want that, now that you have a chance at becoming King Consort."

1179.speaker: Player_Romus
1179.text: "You still want to work with me, after I denied you permission to court my daughter?"

1180.speaker: Manus Sazon
1180.text: "This is bigger than just me, Your Majesty."

1182.speaker: Vina Toras
1182.text: "Our opinions on the subject may differ, but in the end, all three of us share the same goal."

1186.speaker: Manus Sazon
1186.text: "We can get into the specifics later. But it is safe to say that any meaningful reform will require a delegation of legislative control by the King of Rizia."

1187.speaker: Player_Romus
1187.text: "How do you suggest I accomplish that?"

1188.speaker: Player_Romus
1188.text: "I am the King. Once we get back to Rizia, I'll transfer all my powers to the House of Delegates. Done and done."

1189.speaker: Player_Romus
1189.text: "We must proceed carefully. I wouldn't want any of the noble houses getting in the way."

1190.speaker: Vina Toras
1190.text: "Remember, Father, the people officially want the monarchy to stay. The Rizian National Coalition still makes up a majority in parliament."

1191.speaker: Manus Sazon
1191.text: "The House of Delegates is key to this, Your Majesty."

1192.speaker: Manus Sazon
1192.text: "If we try to reform the government against their wishes, your Grand Vizier or any of the other noble houses could use it as justification to oust you from the throne."

1193.speaker: Vina Toras
1193.text: "Exactly. We need a bigger reform movement in Rizia before we can make any major changes."

1194.speaker: Manus Sazon
1194.text: "As long as the Rizian National Coalition holds a parliament majority, they will oppose our attempts at reform. And your Grand Vizier or any of the other nobles could use that as justification to oust you from the throne."

1196.speaker: Manus Sazon
1196.text: "As long as the Rizian National Coalition holds a parliament majority, they will oppose any attempt at reform."

1197.speaker: Manus Sazon
1197.text: "You could override them as king, yes. But Your Grand Vizier or any of the other nobles could use that as justification to oust you from the throne."

1201.speaker: Manus Sazon
1201.text: "It's not that simple, unfortunately. We should not begin this process unless we can marshall a movement behind it."

1203.speaker: Manus Sazon
1203.text: "I will take note of that. An acronym will do. Either way, we need a proper movement in place before we can begin the process."

1204.speaker: Player_Romus
1204.text: "A delegation of legislative control... isn't there a shorter, catchier way to say that?"

1205.speaker: Player_Romus
1205.text: "Are you sure a more democratic Rizia is what you want, Vina? What happened to your dream of becoming another Queen Lyza?"

1207.speaker: Vina Toras
1207.text: "I was naive. Lyza was the best monarch for her time, but the leaders of today should be elected to their positions, not born to them. Manus helped me realize that."

1209.speaker: Vina Toras
1209.text: "I do still have my heart set on becoming queen, though."

1211.speaker: Player_Romus
1211.text: "I'm not sold on making such a sweeping change. Is there anything else I can do to raise your party's changes of success?"

1212.speaker: Player_Romus
1212.text: "As the sovereign leader of this nation, I can pass decrees whenever I want. As long as I have that power, I should exercise it."

1213.speaker: Manus Sazon
1213.text: "They may cause disruptions on election day. But I'm confident they don't represent the opinion of the majority."

1214.speaker: Manus Sazon
1214.text: "Your Majesty, do you mean to say that..."

1215.speaker: Narrator
1215.text: His features contorted as he thought about how to answer.

1216.speaker: Player_Romus
1216.text: "Yes, I do. Get me onto dry land and put a pen in my hand, and I shall pass a decree reforming Rizia's election process." [-6 Authority]

1217.speaker: Narrator
1217.text: Manus and Vina looked at each other excitedly.

1220.speaker: Player_Romus
1220.text: "Is there anything else I can do to help the RPP's election chances?"

1222.speaker: Narrator
1222.text: Manus thought for a moment, a smile still fixed on his face.

1226.speaker: Player_Romus
1226.text: "I shall concentrate all my focus and influence on passing an electoral reform decree prior to next year's elections."

1227.speaker: Player_Romus
1227.text: "Write up a draft of the decree you have in mind. If I agree with it, I will pass it as soon as possible."

1228.speaker: Narrator
1228.text: Manus and Vina looked at each other excitedly.

1231.speaker: Player_Romus
1231.text: "No, on second thought, it's better to conserve resources where I can. What were you saying about finding help?"

1232.speaker: Player_Romus
1232.text: "I can't work with that timeline. Let's reconvene after the elections and I'll see what I can do."

1233.speaker: Vina Toras
1233.text: "But the next elections will be six years away! Who knows what will happen by then..."

1237.speaker: Vina Toras
1237.text: "I'm not a naive little girl anymore, Father. I know that absolute power corrupts, even if its holder has the best of intentions."

1238.speaker: Vina Toras
1238.text: "If Lyza was alive today, I'm sure she'd say the same thing."

1239.speaker: Player_Romus
1239.text: "You two have clearly thought this through. But I can't go along with this plan."

1248.speaker: Player_Romus
1248.text: "Since my coronation, I have come to the realization that I alone can fix Rizia's problems. I am not ready to let go of my power just yet."

1249.speaker: Manus Sazon
1249.text: "You told me as much back in Sallabes. But I thought by now you'd see the necessity of peaceful reforms."

1250.speaker: Player_Romus
1250.text: "It's simply too much of a risk. And I am not even convinced the country will benefit."

1251.speaker: Player_Romus
1251.text: "Do you understand how much pressure I'm under? I can't solve our myriad domestic and international crises while shepherding Rizia through the transition to a functional democracy. Maybe in another decade or so."

1252.speaker: Vina Toras
1252.text: "In another decade, it might be too late! Please, Father. At least hear the rest of what we have to say."

1253.speaker: Vina Toras
1253.text: "It won't be a risk if we do it right! Please, Father. At least hear the rest of what we have to say."

1254.speaker: Manus Sazon
1254.text: "You wouldn't have to let go of all your power, Your Majesty. You could still retain some degree of influence."

1255.speaker: Vina Toras
1255.text: "Please, Father. At least hear the rest of what we have to say."

1256.speaker: Player_Romus
1256.text: "Sorry to disappoint you. But this conversation is over."

1259.speaker: Manus Sazon
1259.text: "Our plan involves the House of Delegates."

1260.speaker: Player_Romus
1260.text: "Did you not hear me the first time? I am not interested."

1261.speaker: Narrator
1261.text: Both Vina and Manus tried to hide their dismay.

1263.speaker: Manus Sazon
1263.text: "I'll send you the electoral reform decree proposal anyway, in case you change your mind."

1264.speaker: Player_Romus
1264.text: "I'm sorry to say that you are on your own. I won't get in the way of your party's campaign, but I won't aid it either."

1265.speaker: Narrator
1265.text: Vina let out a frustrated groan.

1269.speaker: Manus Sazon
1269.text: "Don't worry, love. These things take time."

1271.speaker: Manus Sazon
1271.text: "House Sazon is unfortunately not an option. My family supports the RPP's platform, but won't want to risk losing their Delegate seats."

1272.speaker: Manus Sazon
1272.text: "However, there are corporate interests in Rizia who have expressed their support for the cause. Ones unaffiliated with any noble house."

1273.speaker: Player_Romus
1273.text: "I hope you don't mean who I think you mean."

1277.speaker: Player_Romus
1277.text: "If you mean the person I think you mean, he could indeed be useful."

1278.speaker: Player_Romus
1278.text: "I knew you two were in league!"

1279.speaker: Player_Romus
1279.text: "And which corporate interests would those be?"

1280.speaker: Player_Romus
1280.text: "How could a man like that help our cause?"

1281.speaker: Vina Toras
1281.text: "Father? Manus? Who are you talking about?"

1282.speaker: Narrator
1282.text: Manus gave Vina an apologetic look.

1290.speaker: Vina Toras
1290.text: "What good is taking power away from the Royal Family if we're just going to hand it to an oligarch?"

1294.speaker: Player_Romus
1294.text: "He has kept his word to me so far."

1295.speaker: Player_Romus
1295.text: "Apparently not. Mr. Sazon, you never told Her Highness about the scheme you and Rusty pulled at the House of Delegates?"

1296.speaker: Player_Romus
1296.text: "Mr. Sazon, you never told Her Highness about the scheme you and Rusty pulled at the House of Delegates?"

1297.speaker: Player_Romus
1297.text: "I don't know. But he did express a genuine interest in reform."

1301.speaker: Player_Romus
1301.text: "I trust that he will help us. But not without demanding something in return."

1302.speaker: Player_Romus
1302.text: "He's a gold baron who exploits his workers and tries to bend the law to suit his whim. Of course he can't be trusted."

1303.speaker: Player_Romus
1303.text: "Well said, Vina. Mr. Montoro already thinks the law doesn't apply to him. What will happen without the nobility to keep him in check?"

1304.speaker: Player_Romus
1304.text: "Rusty's business keeps a significant part of the Rizian economy afloat. He's more valuable to this kingdom than we are."

1305.speaker: Player_Romus
1305.text: "Who said anything about handing him power? If he wants to offer support, I have no trouble accepting that."

1307.speaker: Narrator
1307.text: He shrank away from the two of us.

1308.speaker: Manus Sazon
1308.text: "Inviting Mr. Montoro to present a compromised version of our safety proposal was the only way to satisfy key members of my party without losing him as a potential source of funding."

1310.speaker: Narrator
1310.text: He shrank away from the two of us.

1311.speaker: Manus Sazon
1311.text: "Inviting Mr. Montoro to present a compromised version of our safety proposal was the only way to satisfy key members of my party without losing him as a potential source of funding."

1313.speaker: Manus Sazon
1313.text: "Given the right incentive, he will help. I'm sure of that."

1314.speaker: Manus Sazon
1314.text: "He's shown interest in reforming the country. And he's on your side after your House of Delegates decision."

1315.speaker: Manus Sazon
1315.text: "As long as it helps his company, he'll support us. And there's famously no love lost between Rusty and the Rizian nobility."

1316.speaker: Vina Toras
1316.text: "You could have told me, love. I always knew this plan would involve compromise."

1320.speaker: Vina Toras
1320.text: "You could have told me, Mr. Sazon. Compromise was always going to be part of the plan."

1322.speaker: Manus Sazon
1322.text: "I'm sorry I didn't bring this up earlier. To be honest, I'm on the fence about involving Mr. Montoro myself."

1329.speaker: Vina Toras
1329.text: "But Father has the resources to bring the RPP to victory without the need for outside assistance."

1330.speaker: Vina Toras
1330.text: "Father, I'm quite certain you won't need any help to pass the electoral reform decree Manus mentioned. But perhaps Mr. Montoro could be convinced to help fund the RPP's campaign..."

1331.speaker: Vina Toras
1331.text: "With the state of our resources, it will be hard to bring the RPP to victory without outside assistance."

1332.speaker: Player_Romus
1332.text: "I most certainly do. Get me back on to dry land and put a pen in my hand, and I shall pass a decree reforming Rizia's election process." [-6 Authority]

1333.speaker: Narrator
1333.text: Manus and Vina looked at each other excitedly.

1336.speaker: Player_Romus
1336.text: "First things first. Get me back on to dry land and put a pen in my hand, and I shall pass a decree reforming Rizia's election process." [-6 Authority]

1337.speaker: Player_Romus
1337.text: "I will work as hard as I can from now until the election to make an RPP win happen. The last person I want to ask for help is Rusty."

1338.speaker: Player_Romus
1338.text: "Are there any other ways I could help your party, Mr. Sazon? Less resource-intensive ones?"

1342.speaker: Player_Romus
1342.text: "I am open to working with Rusty and RRG. If we're going to go up against the nobility, we will need any help we can get."

1343.speaker: Manus Sazon
1343.text: "That's fine. Thank you for agreeing to work on our behalf."

1345.speaker: Manus Sazon
1345.text: "I'll send you the electoral reform decree proposal as soon as we're back in Porte Drazon. As for other possible ways to help..."

1347.speaker: Player_Romus
1347.text: "In the meantime, what else can I do to help the RPP's election chances?"

1349.speaker: Vina Toras
1349.text: "His workers are the ones with value. He himself is dead weight."

1350.speaker: Vina Toras
1350.text: "A Rizia run by corporations is no better than one run by kings and queens."

1351.speaker: Vina Toras
1351.text: "I've never had the pleasure of conversing with Mr. Montoro. But I can tell you that a man like that never offers his support for free."

1352.speaker: Manus Sazon
1352.text: "Vina, I understand your reservations, but I also know it will take a great deal of money to bring about the change we want. It's useless to pretend otherwise."

1353.speaker: Manus Sazon
1353.text: "He holds influence in Rizia's uppermost of echelons. We can use him to help us in the election, then get rid of him once we don't need him."

1354.speaker: Manus Sazon
1354.text: "The new government will be one of and for the people. He'll have no influence over it."

1355.speaker: Vina Toras
1355.text: "I love you, Manus, but this is madness."

1356.speaker: Manus Sazon
1356.text: "Of that, I have no doubt. But he has also expressed a genuine interest in reforms. If only to 'stick it to the nobles', as he puts it."

1360.speaker: Vina Toras
1360.text: "Perhaps Father's decision to keep us apart was for the best. This is madness."

1361.speaker: Narrator
1361.text: She cast a pleading look in my direction.

1368.speaker: Vina Toras
1368.text: "You have the resources to bring the RPP to victory without the need for outside assistance. You don't even need Mr. Montoro."

1369.speaker: Vina Toras
1369.text: "I know money is tight, but you can reform the Rizian elections without Mr. Montoro's help."

1370.speaker: Vina Toras
1370.text: "I know resources are tight, but surely there's another way."

1371.speaker: Player_Romus
1371.text: "You're right. Get me back on to dry land and put a pen in my hand, and I shall pass a decree reforming Rizia's election process." [-6 Authority]

1372.speaker: Narrator
1372.text: Manus and Vina looked at each other excitedly.

1376.speaker: Manus Sazon
1376.text: "You're right -- both of you. Thank you for agreeing to work on our behalf."

1378.speaker: Manus Sazon
1378.text: "I'll send you the electoral reform decree proposal as soon as we're back in Porte Drazon. As for other possible ways to help..."

1379.speaker: Manus Sazon
1379.text: "Thank you for your understanding, Your Highness. Your Majesty."

1380.speaker: Player_Romus
1380.text: "In the meantime, what else can I do to help the RPP's election chances?"

1382.speaker: Player_Romus
1382.text: "Mr. Sazon, the fact that you would even consider working with Rusty Montoro makes me doubt that you are the right person to reform the country. I'm putting this conversation on hold for now."

1383.speaker: Player_Romus
1383.text: "Sorry, Vina, but I am open to working with Rusty and RRG. If we're going to go up against the nobility, we will need any help we can get."

1385.speaker: Player_Romus
1385.text: "I will work as hard as I can from now until the election to make an RPP win happen. The last person I want to ask for help is Rusty."

1386.speaker: Player_Romus
1386.text: "How else might I be able to help the RPP, without resorting to asking Mr. Montoro for assistance?"

1387.speaker: Manus Sazon
1387.text: "Please, Your Majesty. We don't need to involve RRG at all. Don't let this get in the way of lasting change."

1389.speaker: Vina Toras
1389.text: "We'll speak later, Manus. But yes, Father, don't give up on reforms because of this."

1393.speaker: Vina Toras
1393.text: "If that's the way it must be, I understand. But don't expect me to go above and beyond."

1394.speaker: Vina Toras
1394.text: "It was only a suggestion, Father. There's no need to give up on reforms because of this."

1395.speaker: Player_Romus
1395.text: "Sorry, but my mind's made up. Any friend of Rusty is not a friend of mine."

1398.speaker: Manus Sazon
1398.text: "I'll send you the electoral reform decree proposal anyway, in case you change your mind."

1399.speaker: Player_Romus
1399.text: "All right. Let's talk about how we can engineer an RPP win. Without external funding."

1406.speaker: Player_Romus
1406.text: "Just out of curiosity... when you mentioned 'help' earlier, whom or what did you mean?"

1417.speaker: Player_Romus
1417.text: "I appreciate your initiative, Mr. Sazon. I'm open to involving Rusty in our reform plans."

1418.speaker: Player_Romus
1418.text: "I do not want our reforms tainted by corporate funding. We will leave Rusty and RRG out of this."

1419.speaker: Manus Sazon
1419.text: "I understand that it will not be easy to pass a decree of this magnitude. But with enough hard work, we can push it through before the elections."

1423.speaker: Player_Romus
1423.text: "I don't like the idea of involving RRG. But if that's what it takes to set our reforms in motion, we may have to hold our nose and take the plunge."

1430.speaker: Vina Toras
1430.text: "If that's the way it must be, I understand. But don't expect me to go above and beyond."

1438.speaker: Vina Toras
1438.text: "Let's see how much we can accomplish on our own first."

1452.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1452.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_ManusVinaReformTalk_RustyAssistance"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_OpenToRustyInvolvement"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DontInvolveRusty"] == false) == false

1453.speaker: Player_Romus
1453.text: "As for the question of asking Rizian Royal Gold for assistance..."

1454.speaker: Narrator
1454.text: My daughter and Manus both regarded me apprehensively.

1457.speaker: Player_Romus
1457.text: “Then explain to me why every so-called transition in history ends with a blade at the monarch’s throat."

1458.speaker: Vina Toras
1458.text: “Because those transitions were resisted until the people had no other choice. Peaceful change is only possible when those in power allow it.”

1459.speaker: Player_Romus
1459.text: "Yes, ideally. But ideals often shatter against reality."

1465.speaker: Player_Romus
1465.text: "No. I only told you I'm willing to work with the RPP. But reforming the entire system is out of the question."

1466.speaker: Vina Toras
1466.text: "I shared your reservations, Father. But please listen."
